marketing.ttl: 书亦烧仙草「秋一杯」出圈：公益流浪动物 + 西红柿蛋花汤
marketing.sum: 立秋「秋天的第一杯奶茶」刷屏，书亦烧仙草借流浪猫「胖虎」做爱心大使，买一杯即轻量参与流浪动物救助，销量换算为3.4吨爱心狗粮；限定「西红柿蛋花汤」（西瓜+凤梨+奶冻）华北首日售7万杯，带动超五成门店营收涨40%。
marketing.body: 书亦把视角放在年轻人关注的宠物身上，将流浪猫变成真实品牌IP，用「买奶茶=参与爱心救助」的轻量机制实现低成本社媒裂变，被业内视为『品牌人格从产品提供者转向情绪陪伴者』的样本。

marketing.ttl: CODEMINT纨素之肤 × 13DE MARZO CAFÉ「小熊橙C状态站」9城10店
marketing.sum: 纯净美妆品牌CODEMINT联动潮流饮品店13DE MARZO CAFÉ（8.5-16），覆盖9城10店，上海安福路旗舰店打造「小熊橙C状态站」限时场景，以橙C冰美式面膜为创意核心打通美妆零售与线下潮流消费。
marketing.body: 双品牌客群高度重合：CODEMINT覆盖注重成分的高消费力都市女性，13DE MARZO扎根Z世代打卡商圈。以「日间咖啡提神、夜间面膜修护」构建味觉+护肤联动，跳出美妆餐饮联名仅做视觉包装的浅层模式，提供国货美妆线下多元化运营样本。

marketing.ttl: 洽洽推出休闲食品行业首个自研品牌数字代言人「洽可儿Chacky」
marketing.src: 中国质量新闻 / 头条
marketing.sum: 洽洽食品在北京发布休闲食品行业首个品牌数字代言人「洽可儿Chacky」，同步上线出道单曲与MV，以AI原生数字资产创新品牌品质传播，重构传统休闲食品行业传播模式。
marketing.body: 洽可儿搭载多模态交互、情感感知AI，覆盖线下展厅互动、工艺科普、电商导购、全渠道客服、常态化直播五大场景，将产品质量标准与食品安全知识嵌入数字人交互，让消费者在趣味互动中主动了解品质，是数实融合营销的标志性实践。

marketing.ttl: 曼卡龙「生命万岁」弗里达快闪落地南京中央商场
marketing.sum: 8.15曼卡龙「生命万岁」弗里达联名主题快闪落地南京中央商场，以弗里达故居「蓝房子」为原型，设三大艺术事件与十大沉浸式打卡区，完成黄金珠宝与艺术IP的深度叙事。
marketing.body: 快闪不做图案挪用式浅层合作，而是深度洞察弗里达「逆境生长、接纳缺憾、礼赞生命」精神内核，从艺术解读到原创设计再到线下体验完整链路，把艺术家精神转化为可佩戴艺术表达，回应女性对「意义感」与「自我表达」的深层需求。

marketing.ttl: 茶饮「秋一杯」花样营销再出圈：蜜雪仪式感、古茗方言包材、奈雪刘晓庆
marketing.sum: 立秋「秋天的第一杯奶茶」再度刷屏，多地门店爆单。玩法升级：蜜雪冰城「全款喜提秋天第一杯」取茶仪式、古茗秋日方言限定包材、益禾堂联名高奢艺术家、奈雪联动刘晓庆做心愿见证官。
marketing.body: 从新品、线下仪式感到包材创新与联名，茶饮「秋一杯」营销花样越来越多。在套路化营销内卷下，品牌正通过情绪价值与地域共鸣争夺年轻人，但也面临「新鲜感被耗尽」的隐忧。

tech.ttl: 宇树科技(Unitree)科创板IPO：人形+四足机器人第一股
tech.sum: Unitree Robotics启动科创板IPO，聚焦人形与四足机器人，标志中国具身智能企业进入资本市场新阶段。
tech.body: 作为全球领先的四足/人形机器人公司，宇树IPO折射未来产业（embodied intelligence、未来能源、量子、脑机、6G）正成为「十五五」经济增长新引擎，多家AI芯片与商业航天企业同步推进上市。

tech.ttl: 阿里Qwen成全球下载量最大开源AI模型
tech.sum: Alibaba's Qwen becomes world's most downloaded open AI model，开源生态与多语种能力持续领先。
tech.body: Qwen系列在全球开发者社区下载量登顶，反映中国大模型在开源路线上的全球竞争力；同期苹果确认中国用户Qwen AI集成，显示端侧AI合作深化。

tech.sum: China's DeepSeek upgrades its V4 Pro model，推理与长上下文能力进一步增强。
tech.body: DeepSeek V4 Pro在复杂推理、工具调用与长上下文处理上迭代，延续其高性价比开源策略，持续对闭源模型形成压力。

tech.ttl: 中国AI企业推进南南本地语言模型合作
tech.sum: Chinese AI firms expand South-South local language model cooperation，面向全球南方多语种需求共建模型。
tech.body: 中国AI企业围绕东南亚、非洲、拉美等本地语言场景展开合作，把中文大模型能力适配至小语种，输出「技术+产业系统」，呼应「全球南方共同发展」议题。

tech.ttl: 中国人形机器人厂商上半年占全球出货97%
tech.sum: Chinese humanoid robot makers hold 97% global shipments in H1 2026，量产能力全球领先。
tech.body: 工信部数据显示中国已率先实现人形机器人量产，2025年全球出货份额高达90%，2026年国内产量有望突破10万台；背后是国产大模型能力提升、核心零部件成本下降与场景数据持续积累。

daily.ttl: 习近平就印度尼西亚发生强烈地震向印尼总统致慰问电
daily.sum: 8月17日，国家主席习近平就印度尼西亚发生强烈地震向印尼总统普拉博沃致慰问电，代表中国政府和人民对遇难者表示哀悼，向家属和伤者致以诚挚慰问。
daily.body: 印尼15日发生7.7级地震，造成严重人员伤亡与财产损失。中方表示愿根据印尼方面需要提供积极协助。

daily.ttl: 「清朗·整治AI应用乱象」专项行动已处置账号2.6万余个
daily.sum: 专项行动自2026年4月启动，聚焦未履行大模型备案登记、AI平台安全与审核能力不足、AI数据投毒、生成合成内容标识落实不到位等乱象。
daily.body: 第一阶段累计处置违规AI产品1.4万余款、清理违法违规信息600余万条、处置账号2.6万余个、下架违规AI商品1300余个；8月起进入第二阶段，聚焦虚假信息、暴力低俗、假冒仿冒、侵害未成年人等。

daily.ttl: 印尼7.7级地震 外交部：中方愿提供积极协助
daily.sum: 外交部发言人林剑表示，中方关注印尼地震灾情，对遇难者表示深切哀悼，向家属和受伤人员致以诚挚慰问，愿根据印尼方面需要提供积极协助。
daily.body: 有记者问及印尼15日发生7.7级地震、至少数十人遇难，中方是否将提供援助；外交部作出上述回应。

daily.ttl: 最大汉代彩绘帛画国内跨省首展：马王堆T形帛画亮相上海
daily.src: 上观新闻 / 腾讯新闻
daily.sum: 8月18日起，马王堆三号墓T形帛画接棒亮相上海，系该文物首次走出湖南公开展出，绘有78种图形，研究价值广泛。
daily.body: 作为「马王堆」系列重磅文物的首次跨省展出，T形帛画以其宏大的宇宙观与绘制技艺引发观展热潮，是暑期文博热点之一。

daily.ttl: 中国将修订住房公积金管理相关规定
daily.sum: China to revise regulations on housing provident fund management——住建等领域法规迎来更新，回应居民住房与提取使用需求。
daily.body: 新规拟优化住房公积金的缴存、提取与使用流程，进一步便利缴存人，是民生保障领域的重要调整。

daily.ttl: 俄乌互相打击能源与物流目标，冲突延烧至后勤设施
daily.src: 央视新闻 / 腾讯新闻
daily.sum: 8月17日，俄军通报控制顿涅茨克和扎波罗热两处居民点，并用无人机袭击敖德萨港乌军巡逻艇与多个油罐；乌军称16日夜袭击俄托夫州工厂，摧毁两座炸药生产车间。
daily.body: 能源与物流节点成为双方远程打击重点，局势持续紧张，影响区域能源与供应链稳定。

daily.ttl: 欧盟拟推乌克兰危机以来最广泛对俄制裁
daily.src: 央视新闻 / 腾讯新闻
daily.sum: 欧盟外交与安全政策高级代表卡拉斯表示，计划今年秋季提出新一轮对俄制裁，将是危机全面升级以来范围最广的一轮，受制裁俄实体数量或比现在增加三分之一。
daily.body: 新一轮制裁聚焦能源、金融与关键技术，显示欧洲对俄施压不减。

daily.ttl: 美国对进口无人机及零部件加征最高100%关税
daily.src: 央视新闻 / 腾讯新闻
daily.sum: 美国签署公告，以国家安全为由对进口无人机及零部件征收10%至100%关税；特定大型或热成像无人机及关键组件税率为100%。
daily.body: 部分条款21天后生效、非高度敏感组件180天后生效；分析称2026年上半年中国无人机对美出口额同比下降54.1%，美国占中国无人机出口比重降至3%。

daily.body: 霍尔木兹海峡通航问题持续牵动全球油价与航运；美伊谈判前景不明，地缘风险溢价仍在。

daily.ttl: 胡塞武装声称对沙特炼油厂发动新无人机袭击

听.title: BBC 6 Minute English · Who does the housework? (Ep.260813)
听.body:
Hello, this is 6 Minute English from BBC Learning English. I'm Neil.
And I'm Pippa. When it comes to household chores, jobs like cleaning, washing clothes or looking after the kids, it's often women who do most of the work. Here, two female listeners of BBC World Service programme People Fixing the World share their experiences. Do they sound familiar to you?

Listener 1: I do everything. I do all the house chores, I do the food shopping, I do all the cooking, I clean the bathroom.
Listener 2: Are the chores done equally between me and my husband? No, they're not done equally. I do most of the chores.

Pippa: So, you're a family man, Neil. Do you do your fair share of household chores?
Neil: I think so. My wife works part time and I work full time, so when I'm not working, I do things, and when she's not working, she does things.
Pippa: Yeah, it's similar in my house, so me and my husband try to split things, but it's difficult, isn't it?
Neil: It is.

Pippa: Of course, no one enjoys cleaning the toilet or taking out the bins, but there is a serious side to the issue. Figures from UN Women suggest that every day women around the world spend three hours more than men on unpaid care and domestic work. So, in this episode, we'll be hearing about two projects helping husbands and wives share the housework more fairly.

Neil: The first project is on the remote Indonesian island of Rote. Here, men traditionally work as rice farmers or fishermen, while women look after the home, the children and older people. But with few washing machines and no running water, these domestic chores take a long time.

Pippa: The NGO ARUNGI runs a project trying to change attitudes about the role of the island's women. They work alongside community leaders like Mama Shilpa.

Mama Shilpa: It is expected that the tasks done in the house, like holding the child, feeding the child, washing dishes, cooking, will all be done by the mother.
Ade Mardiyati: Shilpa tells me these are all considered women's work. And you might be thinking, "Well, the man is busy in the fields, so it's just a fair division of labour." But Shilpa tells me women also help out in the fields.

Neil: On Rote, cleaning, cooking and sweeping are considered women's work - a negative term for boring and repetitive tasks which are traditionally done by women.

Pippa: Many cultures have a division of labour - a way of organising work where different tasks are done by different groups of people. But on Rote this means women work even harder, helping out with the farming and fishing too.

Neil: Research suggests that women in wealthy countries also spend much more time on unpaid care work than men. One such country is Croatia, where the NGO Status M run their Superdads project. Project worker Anamarija Soco leads workshops encouraging dads and sons to take some of the pressure off mums.

Anamarija Soco: Mothers have, of course, more space for their careers, or hobbies, or just simply to rest - I mean, just to take a breather. Women tend to especially appreciate men who do these kinds of chores. And when they start pulling their weight, then they jokingly say that, "Yeah, women tend to nag less."

Pippa: Sometimes mums need to take a breather - an informal way of saying stop and rest a while.
Neil: Anamarija also thinks women appreciate it when their husbands pull their weight. If you pull your weight, you work as hard as everyone else.

Pippa: Both these NGO projects agree about one thing - men doing more to help around the house results in happier homes, even if that means cleaning the toilet now and then.

[Quiz answer: the most hated household chore in Britain is cleaning the windows - 23% of survey respondents.]

Vocabulary:
- chores: tasks around the home (cleaning, washing, ironing) done regularly
- fair share: a reasonable amount
- women's work: negative term for boring, repetitive tasks stereotypically done by women
- division of labour: organising work so different tasks are done by different groups
- take a breather: (idiom) stop and rest a short while
- pull your weight: work as hard as everyone else doing the same job
听.zh: 本期BBC 6分钟英语探讨「谁来做家务」：全球女性平均每天比男性多花3小时在无酬照护与家务上。节目介绍印尼Rote岛与克罗地亚「Superdads」两个项目，推动夫妻更公平分担家务。重点词汇：chores（家务）、fair share（合理份额）、women's work（被视为女性专做的重复性琐事）、division of labour（劳动分工）、take a breather（歇口气）、pull one's weight（尽本分/出一份力）。趣味问答：英国人最讨厌的家务是擦窗户（23%）。

说.title: Speaking · Share the chores
说.body: Describe one household chore you dislike most and explain whether chores should be shared equally between partners. Try to use at least three of today's vocabulary words: chores, fair share, women's work, division of labour, take a breather, pull one's weight. Speak for 90 seconds.
说.zh: 口语练习：描述你最讨厌的一项家务，并说明夫妻/室友之间是否应该平均分担家务。尽量用上今天学到的至少3个词：chores、fair share、women's work、division of labour、take a breather、pull one's weight。说满90秒。

读.title: Reading · Large AI models, terminals transform eldercare (China Daily)
读.body:
Large AI models, terminals transform eldercare
By YAN DONGJIE in Tianjin | China Daily | Updated: 2026-08-18 10:12

Zhang Weirong, 76, ordered food by speaking to his desktop device supported by an AI agent this morning as usual, with the voice request transmitted to the community canteens, allowing him to pick up prepared dishes or arrange door-to-door delivery.

This everyday scene at Yuexiu road in Hexi district of Tianjin exemplifies a flagship artificial intelligence senior care initiative jointly developed by Baidu Intelligent Cloud and local elderly care operator Zhongmin Jukang.

With Baidu's Wenxin large language model identifying seniors' voice requests and generating service orders within the community senior care network, elderly residents can gain well-rounded support from volunteers, community doctors and other supporting service facilities.

Yuexiu road alone is home to over 22,000 seniors, with 30 percent equipped with the You'aixiaoxin desktop care robot and regularly accessing convenient services through AI terminals.

China is witnessing unprecedented demographic pressure from population aging. Official data from the National Bureau of Statistics show the country had 323.38 million people aged 60 and above by the end of last year, accounting for 23 percent of the total population, with the elderly dependency ratio climbing steadily.

After integrating Wenxin LLM and multi-agent coordination systems, each caregiver can efficiently support 120 to 150 seniors, greatly lifting service efficiency and making AI an indispensable digital supplement to the eldercare system, said Zhan Hengbo, chairman of Zhongmin Jukang.

"AI does not replace human companionship, but it extends care capacity to 24-hour coverage, turns passive service responses into proactive risk intervention, and bridges the digital divide for elderly groups unfamiliar with complex electronic devices," Du Peng, a leading national gerontology expert, said.

Beyond daily amenities, built-in millimeter-wave radars and linked smart mattresses detect potential falls, immediately alerting seniors, their family members and community emergency responders to secure home safety.
读.zh: 中国日报（2026-08-18）报道：天津河西区越秀路借助百度智能云与中民聚康联合打造的AI养老项目，独居老人对着桌面终端说话即可下单社区食堂餐食或预约上门配送。百度文心大模型识别语音需求并生成服务工单，使每位护理员可高效服务120-150位老人（此前仅20-30位）。内置毫米波雷达与智能床垫还能监测跌倒并即时报警。专家强调：AI不替代陪伴，而是把照护能力延伸至24小时、化被动响应为主动干预，并弥合老年群体的数字鸿沟。截至去年底，中国60岁以上人口达3.23亿，占总人口23%。

写.title: Writing · Should AI take over eldercare?
写.body: Write a 150-word opinion piece titled 'Should AI take over eldercare?'. Refer to the reading article about Baidu's Wenxin LLM senior-care model in Tianjin. State your view and give two reasons. Use at least one phrase from today's vocabulary.
写.zh: 写作练习：以「AI应该接管养老吗？」为题写一篇150词议论文，参考今日阅读里天津文心大模型养老项目的案例，表明你的观点并给出两个理由，至少使用一个今日词汇。

练.title: Practice · Vocabulary (household & work)
练.body:
Fill in the blanks with the correct word: chores / fair share / division of labour / take a breather / pull your weight.
1. After a long meeting, let's ___ and grab a coffee.
2. In our team, everyone must ___ or the project will fail.
3. She does all the ___ — cooking, cleaning and shopping.
4. A clear ___ helps the family run smoothly.
5. Dad finally does his ___ of the housework on weekends.
(Answer key: 1. take a breather 2. pull your weight 3. chores 4. division of labour 5. fair share)
练.zh: 词汇填空练习：用 chores / fair share / division of labour / take a breather / pull your weight 填空。答案：1.take a breather 2.pull your weight 3.chores 4.division of labour 5.fair share。
